scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run check -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/tests frontend/app frontend/next.config.ts e2e playwright.config.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/tests frontend/app frontend/next.config.ts e2e playwright.config.ts README.md
